style_bible.palette: sodium amber and ash grey against deep teal-black; one warm paper white; firelight only where fire is present
style_bible.lighting: one hard practical per scene, negative fill, visible darkness; corridor cold, 4A warm with an intermittent blue-white spark, hotel blue, final frame firelit from one side
style_bible.lens: 24mm for wides and overheads, 50mm for mediums, 100mm macro for print and hands; shallow focus, subtle halation
style_bible.grain: fine 16mm grain, gentle contrast, blacks that keep texture; no digital clarity sheen
style_bible.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, cartoon, anime, oversaturated, stock-photo smile, modern social UI, fisheye, duplicate faces, floating objects, illegible gibberish text

music.mood: low cello pulse, tape hiss, one distant piano note; no percussion until the smoke; the piano stops when Mara's name appears

scenes.narration: Elias's paper had his obituary. It arrived a day early: his name, his apartment, a fire at 3:07. He was alive.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up on a folded broadsheet: tomorrow's date and a short obituary box dominate the frame. At the edges, living ink-stained fingers hold the paper; behind it, Elias's unshaven face is a dark shape. The page is the only bright object. A low-opacity wordmark sits in the top margin from the first frame; there is no logo card.
characters: Elias Voss - 34, gaunt, dark wool coat, close-cropped hair, ink-stained fingers, sleepless
scenes.environment: Kitchen table in apartment 4B, predawn; cold coffee ring, unopened mail, one bare bulb, rain on the window
scenes.lighting: Hard overhead bulb; the newspaper is overexposed, the room falls to black at the edges; no fill on Elias's face
scenes.camera: 100mm macro, top-down; slow pull-back from the obituary type to the hands and the dark shape of his face, 9:16
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 macro still, tomorrow's newspaper on a dark kitchen table, a short obituary column under a hard bare bulb, living ink-stained fingers holding the page, a gaunt man's face half-hidden behind it, cold coffee ring, rain-streaked window, teal shadows, sodium amber light, 100mm lens, shallow focus, fine 16mm grain, no legible body text, faint wordmark in top margin

scenes.narration: He had no subscription. Underneath, in small print: one name per fire.
scenes.visual: Macro on the bottom corner of the same page. Elias's fingertip traces a line of tiny print beneath a subscription notice. The words ONE NAME PER FIRE sit in a ruled box, almost too small to photograph. The paper fibres and a coffee stain are visible.
characters: Elias Voss - fingertip and cuff only, ink under the nail
scenes.environment: Kitchen table, paper edge, cold coffee ring, cheap letter opener
scenes.lighting: Low raking desk lamp from the right; the fine print is in a hard pool of light, the rest of the page falls to black
scenes.camera: 100mm macro, slight handheld drift, rack focus from the subscription notice to the fine-print rule, 9:16

scenes.narration: At 2:40, Elias knocked on 4A. Mara's heater had been sparking all week.
scenes.visual: Wide low-angle corridor. Elias stands at 4A, small in frame, one hand raised to knock. Under Mara's door, a blue-white spark stutters across the carpet and dies. The other doors are shut; the stairwell light pulses.
characters: Elias Voss - at 4A door, back three-quarters to camera, coat collar up
scenes.environment: Narrow 1970s corridor, mustard wallpaper, worn carpet, one caged stairwell bulb, a thin line of warm light under 4A
scenes.lighting: Hard sodium stairwell light; the spark throws a brief cold blue flash on the carpet; long shadows toward camera

scenes.narration: She'd asked him to fix it. He told her to call the super.
scenes.visual: Over Elias's shoulder at 4A. Mara stands in the doorway in a cardigan, tired and defensive. Behind her, the coil heater pops and spits a blue spark; the thin curtain lifts. Elias's knuckles are still raised in the foreground. The faulty heater is unmistakable.
characters: Elias Voss - foreground shoulder and raised hand, coat collar up
Mara Kwan - 60s, cardigan, reading glasses pushed into grey hair, tired but alert
scenes.environment: 4A doorway; warm cluttered flat beyond, coil heater against a thin curtain, stack of unopened letters
scenes.lighting: Warm interior spill against cold corridor; the heater element is the hottest point, with an intermittent cold blue spark

scenes.narration: He took the stairs and didn't look back.
scenes.visual: Wide low-angle stairwell. Elias descends, one hand on the rail, coat billowing; his shadow climbs the wall behind him. The corridor door is a bright rectangle above him, already out of reach.
characters: Elias Voss - centered low on the stairs, back to camera, one hand on rail

scenes.lighting: Single caged bulb above; hard vertical shadows; cold blue below, warm sodium above

scenes.narration: From the hotel, he watched the smoke rise. At 3:07, 4B burned.
scenes.visual: Hotel window at night. Elias stands at the left edge, silhouetted; his reflection overlaps the city. Far right, a thin column of smoke rises from his building, lit amber at the base. The window frame traps him between his reflection and the fire.
characters: Elias Voss - left third, back to camera, silhouette and reflection

scenes.lighting: Blue room, amber smoke glow outside, no overhead light; reflection doubles his outline

scenes.narration: The next paper waited at the front desk. Same fire. Same hour. Different name.
scenes.visual: High-angle close-up of the hotel front desk. A fresh broadsheet sits beside a brass bell and a room key. The clerk's hand withdraws from frame. The paper is folded to the obituary page, and the room key still has a paper tag.
characters: Hotel clerk - hand only, withdrawing from frame
scenes.environment: Hotel reception, laminate counter, brass bell, key cubbies, wet glass ring
scenes.lighting: Single desk lamp, hard pool of light; background dark; paper is the brightest object

scenes.narration: Mara Kwan. Apartment 4A. It said she'd entered 4B to warn him.
scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of the second obituary. Elias's thumb presses beside the name MARA KWAN. Below it, a smaller line reads: ENTERED 4B TO WARN OCCUPANT. A line of ash crosses the date. The paper is damp and puckered. The subhead is the only sharp thing in frame.
characters: Elias Voss - thumb and cuff only

scenes.narration: Elias laid the two obituaries side by side. His name. Mara's.
scenes.visual: Top-down on the bare floor. Exactly two broadsheets: Elias's obituary on the left, Mara's on the right, both edged in red pencil. Elias kneels between them, one hand on each page. His shadow joins the two sheets. There are no other editions in frame.
characters: Elias Voss - kneeling between the two papers, sleeves rolled, head lowered

scenes.narration: The paper wasn't predicting the future. It was choosing who paid for it.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Elias's face, right third, lit from the left by the burning building through the window. A blank newspaper fills the lower foreground. He looks directly at camera for the first time. The low-opacity wordmark sits in the top margin; there is no end card and no logo intro.
characters: Elias Voss - close-up, soot on cheek, no expression left to read
